caption: Figure 5. The design overview of the COMET-W4Ax kernel. (a) illustrates the tile-based GEMM computing with mixed- precision encoding. (b) presents the computing procedure when issuing W4A4 and W4A8 GEMM instructions simultaneously. (c) shows that we can effectively hide the overhead by software pipe

templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from n-panel-comparison by the note-writer: three diagram kinds, a tile/tensor layout, a circuit-style instruction-issue diagram, and a buffer-by-iteration timeline grid, explain one design from three angles rather than repeating one drawing under different designs; this is composite-figure, not n-panel-comparison.
templates.what_to_learn: When three panels each use a different diagram type (a data-layout grid, a circuit diagram, a scheduling timeline) to explain complementary aspects of one system, file the figure as composite-figure with a dominant panel, not n-panel-comparison, which needs one shared drawing style repeated across the panels.
